quellen.description: How does the integration detect a ring, and where do the snapshot and the recording stream come from?

sip.title: Intercom
sip.description: Extensions of the door station and the tablet. The list comes from sip-core and the Asterisk integration; custom values are allowed. The state sensors are derived from them.

sensoren.title: State sensors
sensoren.description: These sensors of the Asterisk integration were not found automatically for extensions {ext_door} and {ext_tablet}. Select them or leave them empty; without the door station state sensor a recording only stops after the maximum length.

haus.title: House
haus.description: Alarm panel and door lock appear in the card; both are optional and can be changed later in the options. mailbox, ansage and freizeichen are created below the base folder.

data.idle_state: Idle state of the door station

umzug.title: Change folder
umzug.description: The base folder changes from {alt} to {neu}. The old folder holds {nachrichten} messages, {ansagen} announcements and {freizeichen} ringback files. With the switch on they are moved to the new folder; files with the same name in the target are left untouched. Afterwards the integration reloads and reads the folders.

data.dateien_verschieben: Move files to the new folder

error.move_failed: Moving failed, the base folder was not changed. Check the target folder and permissions.
